description: Change one catalogue entry (one course in one language) or add a new one. Only the given fields change; the whole entry is then validated (short_description 30-200 characters without links, at least 2 learning objectives, at least 1 skill, https thumbnails and deep link, duration in whole minutes) and nothing is saved if anything is missing. The change appears in the public feed at once and at customers with the next connector sync. Deactivate with is_active=false instead of deleting. Only admins of the tenant that runs the catalogue; called by an agent, the change is parked for human approval.

course.description: course key, e.g. user, developer, consultant, user_compact (new key = new course)

deep_link.description: https URL of the course page (without a licence: the purchase page)

is_active.description: false = withdraw from customers' catalogues at the next sync (entry stays in the feed as inactive)

thumbnail_16x9_url.description: https URL of the 16:9 preview image

thumbnail_3x2_url.description: https URL of the 3:2 preview image

name: update_lms_catalog_entry
